summary: CloudCam AI: add required user authentication via Internet Identity (basic sign-up/login only).
architectural_notes: Authentication must use Internet Identity only; custom email/password accounts are not supported on the platform.

existing_features.title: Make Internet Identity the only supported sign-up/login method for CloudCam AI and ensure the app provides a clear, working login flow via the existing /login route.

Require authentication (Internet Identity) to use CloudCam AI features by enforcing route protection for all feature pages (at minimum: Dashboard and Camera) and redirecting unauthenticated users to /login.

Ensure a basic user account record is created and persisted for each authenticated principal the first time they use the app, without requiring any additional profile fields beyond what already exists (principal, createdAt, tier).
Update all user-facing product name/branding text in the UI to consistently say “CloudCam AI” (English), replacing inconsistent references (e.g., “CloutChem AI”).

new_feature_requests.summary: Implement required user accounts (sign-up/login) using Internet Identity only; basic authentication only (no additional profile data yet).
